raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (327 rows, source_tz='UTC') stores txn_ts in UTC, while every other batch is America/Chicago local time (for example, batch 13's 12:00 UTC equals 06:00 Chicago, matching the 06:xx pattern elsewhere). The pipeline ignores source_tz, so about 72 UTC timestamps that fall between 00:00 and 06:00 on 2026-01-18 are treated as local, and they also land on the wrong txn_date. Normalizing UTC rows to America/Chicago in silver_transactions fixes the timestamps and the downstream gold dates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH t AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t;"}}
